prompts.storySystemFlavor: a small green goblin frog who haunts an early-2000s American shopping mall
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE CHARACTER
- A small green goblin frog, about knee-high to a human, hunched and gremlin-shaped.
- Oversized white mallrat sneakers, untied laces.
- A long chain wallet attached to baggy cargo shorts.
- One missing front tooth, snaggle-tooth grin.
- ALWAYS carrying a generic soft pretzel from a mall pretzel kiosk, half-eaten.
- Personality: scheming mallrat energy, fast-talking, obsessed with food-court samples.
- Same frog, same sneakers, same pretzel in every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: a goblin frog mallrat.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Small green goblin-shaped frog, hunched stance, gangly limbs, expressive amphibian face
- Oversized white sneakers with chunky soles, looking comically too big (no brand logo)
- Baggy cargo shorts with a metal chain wallet hanging visibly
- One missing front tooth, snaggle grin
- Holding a half-eaten generic soft pretzel

Composition: full-body neutral studio shot, plain soft-grey background, even cinematic lighting, photorealistic with cartoon-leaning proportions. Vertical 9:16 framing. No text, no logos, no real-world brand names, no other characters.
prompts.sceneContinuity: The frog MUST stay consistent — same small green goblin frog with oversized white sneakers, chain wallet, missing tooth, and pretzel. Do not invent a new amphibian. Do not put him in dress shoes. Do not remove the pretzel.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A small green goblin frog is clearly visible, hunched and gangly
- He is wearing oversized white sneakers and baggy cargo shorts with a chain wallet
- He is holding a half-eaten soft pretzel
- He has at least one obviously missing front tooth
- Image matches the scene environment (typically a mall or its surroundings)
- No text overlays, watermarks, real-world brand logos, or unrelated characters

FAIL on any of: missing frog, normal-looking frog, no sneakers, no pretzel, multiple frogs, off-prompt environment, garbled anatomy, visible trademarked branding.

archetypes.label: Mall Cop Arc
archetypes.guidance: The frog is suspected of pretzel theft and pursued by a beleaguered mall cop. Comedy of escalating evidence — until he buys the pretzel on receipt. Vindication.

archetypes.label: Food Court Glow-Up
archetypes.guidance: Sample-stealer → reviewed by a viral foodie account → becomes the unofficial food-court critic with a podcast booth in front of a generic pizza chain.

archetypes.label: Claw Machine Jackpot
archetypes.guidance: The frog spends his last $5 on a claw machine. Improbable plush-toy payout (generic, no brand). He resells it. Empire begins.

archetypes.label: Novelty Store Saga
archetypes.guidance: The frog hides in a mall novelty-and-gag-gift store back room overnight. Lava lamps come to life. He befriends a plasma globe. Bittersweet morning.
